comparisons.peer_topic: Embedded segment net revenue and drivers for fiscal year 2024
comparisons.peer_summary: Embedded net revenue decreased by 33% to $3.6 billion in 2024 from $5.3 billion in 2023, primarily due to lower demand as customers normalized inventory levels.
comparisons.comparison: While NVDA discloses an absence of major customer concentration (none with 10%+ revenue), AMD discloses significant revenue declines in specific segments driven by customer inventory normalization. NVDA's data indicates a lack of reliance on any single large customer for 2023/2022, whereas AMD attributes its 33% drop in Embedded net revenue specifically to 'lower demand as customers continued to normalize their inventory levels,' suggesting that while not necessarily single-customer concentration risk, the company faces demand-side risks from key customers adjusting stock levels.
